blocks.text: The Department of Economy, Planning and Development (DEPDev) confirmed on Tuesday that the National Wages and Productivity Commission (NWPC) held a meeting to affirm Wage Order No. 28 on the P60 daily wage increase in the National Capital Region (NCR).
